question: Which of the following ratios is greatest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert each **ratio** into a **decimal** value to compare easily.

21 ÷ 45 ≈ 0.466

25 ÷ 50 = 0.500

20 ÷ 36 ≈ 0.555

17 ÷ 42 ≈ 0.404

**∴ The correct answer is 20 : 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/504e92ead4b986d9a98ed9658b25f226d9bad0b0a0cbb0a79a726ec6ff33a228.png] 

**Given:** Ratios are 21:45, 25:50, 20:36, and 17:42.

**Method:** Convert all **fractions** to a **common denominator** or **decimal form**.

⇒ 21/45 = 7/15 ≈ 0.466

⇒ 25/50 = 1/2 = 0.5

⇒ 20/36 = 5/9 ≈ 0.555

⇒ 17/42 ≈ 0.404

⇒ Comparing the values: 0.555 > 0.500 > 0.466 > 0.404

**∴ The correct answer is 20 : 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Comparison of Fractions

To compare a/b and c/d, cross-multiply: if ad > bc, then a/b > c/d.

Compound Ratio

The **compound ratio** of a:b and c:d is (a × c) : (b × d).

Percentage Conversion

Multiply the **ratio** by 100 to find its percentage value; for example, 20:36 ≈ 55.55%.</p
